name: Beneath Floes
source:
Qikiqtaaluk, 1962. The sun falls below the horizon and won't return for months. You wander the broken shoreline, wary of your mother's stories about the qalupalik. Fish woman, stealer of wayward children: she dwells beneath the ice.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220704225154/https://www.bravemule.com/beneathfloes/]official site[/url]]
translation:
1962年，基基克塔卢克。太阳沉入地平线，数月之内都不会再升起。你沿着崎岖的海岸徘徊，心中戒备着母亲讲过的卡鲁帕利克传说。那是一个会掳走不听话孩子的鱼身女人，栖身于冰层之下。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220704225154/https://www.bravemule.com/beneathfloes/]官方网站[/url]]
